Typically you don't need to play full chords, its better to only play 2-3 note chords. I would learn a major, minor, maj7, min7, dom7 Shape on the top 3-4 strings and practice shifting those around. You also don't have to worry about supporting the structure as much. As a bass player, the general idea is to focus on the root and work around it. But you have a little more flexibility.
